extends: scripts/w2r1/prereg.json (unchanged, sha256 6caf1f70ad2a926b368927c521d799311f09191963bf17c957c6959701cb521d). No threshold, label or split is changed here.
declared_before: any S5 model fit, any S5 validation scoring, any look at 2026 outcomes. S4 stays DIAGNOSTIC / validation-only and is not mixed into S5.
objective: Test whether point-in-time TACTICAL evidence adds reliable INCREMENTAL forecast value beyond (a) the champion B1p and (b) the W2.P1 Role candidate C2. A valid result is NO RELIABLE INCREMENTAL GAME-PLAN SIGNAL for any or all positions. The prior player-scheme interaction research was a clean null: interactions carry the burden of proof.

splits.VAL: 2025 weeks 3-17 (the W2.P1 world rows; weeks 14-17 are VAL-contaminated by W2.P1 and used only for validation here)
splits.FINAL: 2026 weeks 1-5: NOT loaded, NOT scored (S7 only, after FROZEN.json)

scope.scoring: HALF primary (identical to W2.P1); STD/PPR robustness reported at S7 only

population: identical to W2.P1: B0p(HALF) >= 3, covered row, headline designations NONE/QUESTIONABLE/DOUBTFUL (OUT only for the exactly-zero contribution check). VAL candidates are scored on the intersection of the W2.P1 world rows and rows with the candidate's features; coverage is reported.

champions_controls.B0p: mean of the previous up to 4 games' HALF points (same season; >= 1 prior game)
champions_controls.B1p: evaluateInjuryModel(B0p, historical designation, CONDITIONAL_ON_ACTIVE) — availability is applied EXACTLY ONCE, here
champions_controls.C2: the W2.P1 Role candidate as frozen in scripts/w2p1/FROZEN.json (fit on 2025 weeks 3-9 DEV; in-sample for those weeks => conservative for challengers)
champions_controls.target: actual HALF points - B0p on rows where the player played and designation in {NONE, QUESTIONABLE, DOUBTFUL}; every candidate predicts a CONDITIONAL-ON-ACTIVE delta; expected = evaluateInjuryModel(B0p + delta). No S5 layer re-discounts availability.

evidence_tiers.tier_A: play-by-play, FTN charting, schedules/lines/weather, player stats, snap counts, injury designations (same definition every season 2022-2026). The ONLY features in the primary candidates (G1-G4).
evidence_tiers.tier_B: participation-derived formation / personnel / coverage-shell / man-zone. NOT published for 2026. Allowed only as a separately labelled variant `G2b`: PRIOR-SEASON carryover (season-1 only), shrunk to the league mean by the continuity factor, carrying evidence age and continuity. Never presented as observed target-season truth.
tier_B_features: def_man_rate (prior season, team defense, man vs zone)
def_two_high_rate (prior season, team defense, coverage shells COVER_2/COVER_4/COVER_6/2_MAN)
evidence_tiers.tier_B_formula: value = cont * prior_season_rate + (1 - cont) * league_mean; cont = HC_same?1:0.4 * QB_same?1:0.6 (offense) / HC_same?1:0.4 (defense); 0.5^(1) age factor applied on the weight in the confidence rule, not in the value

as_of_rule: every feature for a target game g of team T uses only games with (season, week) strictly earlier than g; schedule lines/weather are pregame; injury designations are the reconstructed FINAL team-week designation (RECONSTRUCTED_FINAL_DESIGNATION, symmetric for every candidate and the control).

factors.OC_changed: UNKNOWN (coordinator registry is empty; absent => NO extra discount per the repo guardrail, flagged oc_dc_unknown)
factors.personnel: UNAVAILABLE (no historical rosters): flagged, no discount

modes_compared.MULTI: previous up to 10 games across seasons, equal weight
modes_compared.CONT: previous up to 10 games across seasons; prior-season games weighted 0.5^(seasons_ago) x continuity factor

continuity.selection: the tactical mode per position is the one with the lowest VAL MAE among {CUR, MULTI, CONT}; ties -> CUR (simplest); CONT is NOT assumed to win
continuity.rate_estimator: (sum_i w_i * r_i + k0 * league_mean) / (sum_i w_i + k0), k0 = 4 game-equivalents, league_mean = FIT mean; r_i = the game's ratio statistic

RL_role_lite_tierA.description: own as-of usage substrate from pbp/snap counts (NOT the W2.P1 Role forecast): empirical-Bayes per-game usage over the previous up to 6 games, k0 = 3

not_built: formation features (Tier B only, not observed in 2026)

feature_families.G3_interactions_limit: AT MOST these five products, each a product of ONE player fingerprint and ONE opponent response: WR/TE x_deep = f_deep_target_share*d_deep_target_concession; QB x_press = f_sack_sensitivity*d_sack_rate; QB x_pa_blitz = f_play_action_share*d_blitz_rate; RB x_rb_press = f_rb_target_share*d_blitz_rate; all x_rz = player rz share * d_rz_td_rate_allowed. No other interaction may be added after seeing results (any later idea is EXPLORATORY).
G4_second_order: so_missing_target_share (as-of target share of teammates designated OUT this week)
so_missing_rush_share (as-of carry share of teammates OUT)
feature_families.second_order_rule: second-order candidates may only use features built from point-in-time injury designations and as-of shares; the direct-backup-only rule (treating a teammate's absence as an add-on to one named backup) is the CONTROL and is not used as a feature

position_hypotheses.QB: pressure-prone QBs lose points against pass-rush-heavy defenses (x_press); play-action QBs gain against blitzing defenses (x_pa_blitz). Prior: weak (W2.P1 QB incremental signal was weak).
position_hypotheses.RB: receiving RBs gain against blitz-heavy defenses (x_rb_press); goal-line backs gain against weak red-zone defenses (x_rz).
position_hypotheses.WR: deep receivers gain against deep-conceding defenses (x_deep); teammate absence redistributes targets (so_missing_target_share).
position_hypotheses.TE: red-zone TEs gain against weak red-zone defenses (x_rz); underneath TEs gain against pressure. Prior: TE was the weakest W2.P1 case.

candidate_ladder.G2: G1 + offense_tendency + defense_response + player_fingerprint (Tier A; 3 continuity modes -> one chosen per position on VAL)
candidate_ladder.G2b: G2 (chosen mode) + Tier-B carryover features (labelled variant, never the primary)
candidate_ladder.model: per-position, per-scoring ridge regression on standardized features, intercept unpenalized; ridge grid [1,10,100,1000] chosen on VAL MAE of the FINAL EXPECTED value (ties -> larger lambda); shrinkage delta = confidence_weight * clamp(prediction, -cap, +cap), cap = max(1.0, 0.25*B0p) (prereg)
candidate_ladder.inclusion_rule: each step must improve MAE vs the PREVIOUS retained step by >= 0.03 points with a 95% cluster-bootstrap (team-week, B=2000, seed 20261014) lower bound > 0; a step that fails is NOT retained and later steps are measured against the last retained step. Interaction step: must beat the additive G2 under the same rule. Anything that does not beat B1p AND C2 (T2b: >= 0.03, lower bound > 0 vs C2) is not an S7 candidate.
candidate_ladder.internal_check: to reduce selection optimism a second view is reported: lambda and the mode chosen on VAL weeks 3-9 only, scored on VAL weeks 10-17 (VAL-LATE)

confidence_and_missing_evidence.confidence_weight: HIGH/MEDIUM 1.0 when the player has >= 4 prior games and both team evidence windows have >= 4 games (CUR: current-season games); LOW 0.6 when 2-3; INSUFFICIENT 0 when < 2 (delta = 0, neutral WITH the missing-evidence reason; coverage reports it)
evidence_state_labels: STALE_EVIDENCE (last relevant game > 21 days before kickoff)
PRIOR_SEASON_ONLY (current-season n < 2 and a prior-season window used)
confidence_and_missing_evidence.rule: missing tactical evidence is never converted into a neutral high-confidence matchup grade: unknown stays unknown, the delta is 0, the label and reason are reported, and the row counts against coverage

metrics: Holm-adjusted p across the 4 positions (family alpha 0.05, one-sided bootstrap p for dMAE>0 vs the best control)

leakage_controls.poison: recompute every feature for sampled VAL rows after replacing the target game and every later game of the team (and the player) with absurd values: features must be byte-identical
leakage_controls.season_end_aggregates: assert that no feature column is a function of games at or after the target (checked by the poison test and by a structural test that every as-of function reads only rows with index < current)
leakage_controls.postgame_injury: designations are the reconstructed final team-week designation used identically by control and candidates; no postgame-only injury field is read
leakage_controls.tier_b: assert the primary candidate feature matrix contains NO participation-derived column; G2b columns must equal values computed from season-1 only (checked against a recomputation with all later data poisoned)
leakage_controls.target_outcome: the target game's own usage/outcome never participates in a feature (poison test); ORACLE control = target-game actual usage as features must beat every candidate by >= 25% of the champion MAE (harness sensitivity)

explainability_contract: each candidate row can emit {likely_offensive_tendency, likely_defensive_response, player_fit_or_mismatch, second_order_effect, confidence, evidence_age, provenance, tier, continuity}. Wording is probabilistic ('tends to', 'historically'), never a claim about an unpublished game plan.
stop_point: validation only; FROZEN.json is not created or modified; 2026 weeks 1-5 are not loaded.
